64461: Although I am already the queen, the affairs of Redpineland continue according to my mother's arrangements, and I have very little to do: sign, meet, sign, meet... #rMy mother comforts me, saying that after I adapt to the queen's position, I can make any changes I want, but for now, I have to endure for a while, yet I already have the power to arrange court Positions. #rFirst, at tomorrow's appointment ceremony, I will appoint Leavitt as the Royal Court's Chief Artist, Chief Scriptwriter, and Court Historian; the first two Positions have no precedent, but I can invent them, and I think the ministers won't mind. #rI have to tear open the breach step by step, gradually replacing the people in the Royal Court with those I admire, but this process cannot be too fast. Clainard is my candidate for Finance Minister, but his qualifications are still shallow, so I can only appoint him as a scribe in a corner of the appointment document. #rI have gradually replaced a batch of those maids; I need to grasp all the news in the court, and the news I don't want to spread must not spread.
64462: As I expected, in matters of personnel appointments and removals, the Ministers only voiced some token objections, and I refuted them one by one, smoothly completing the personnel transfers. 64463: My future husband, Olga Nowitz arrived at the court; he is much older than me and looks very strong. #rBut within just one day, I found it increasingly difficult to get along with him; his language was vulgar, and he always talked about topics like hunting, war, horseback riding, and so on. #rMy mother advised me to handle the relationship with my future husband... 64465: Olga was left at the royal court to reflect behind closed doors. For this visit, I brought quite a few attendants. 64467: Before returning to Redpineland, my caravan tripled in length—the wealth and generosity of Chen-Yuan's people astounded me.
